scores.question: Which agreements give a party audit rights?
scores.answer:
The following agreements grant audit rights or equivalent rights to inspect accounting records:

- **Bellring Manufacturing Agreement** — Premier may inspect, copy, and audit Heritage’s agreement-related records upon reasonable request during normal business hours, subject to limits on accounting and purchasing records. [BellringBrandsInc_20190920_S-1_EX-10.12_11817081_EX-10.12_Manufacturing Agreement1.pdf p. 5]
- **Etelos Distributor Agreement** — Tripath may audit the distributor’s product sales and inventory records at Tripath’s expense, with prior written notice. [ETELOS,INC_03_09_2004-EX-10.8-DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT.PDF p. 5]
- **Fuse Medical Distributor Agreement** — The Supplier may inspect the distributor’s product sales and distribution accounts and records on reasonable notice, no more than once annually. [FuseMedicalInc_20190321_10-K_EX-10.43_11575454_EX-10.43_Distributor Agreement.pdf p. 5]
- **GPAQ Service Agreement** — The HOF Entities may audit Constellation’s relevant New Business records each January for the preceding calendar year, at their written request and expense. [GpaqAcquisitionHoldingsInc_20200123_S-4A_EX-10.8_11951679_EX-10.8_Service Agreement.pdf p. 9]
- **Integrity Media Co-Branding Agreement** — Either party may inspect the other’s books concerning contractual obligations, at its own expense with 30 days’ written notice, subject to frequency and time limits. [IntegrityMediaInc_20010329_10-K405_EX-10.17_2373875_EX-10.17_Co-Branding Agreement.pdf p. 4]
- **Midwest Energy Emissions Content License Agreement** — Licensors may inspect the Company’s books, records, and materials relating to their licensed content upon reasonable notice. [MidwestEnergyEmissionsCorp_20080604_8-K_EX-10.2_3093976_EX-10.2_Content License Agreement.pdf p. 3]
- **Steel Vault Affiliate Agreement** — Equidata may audit the Marketing Affiliate’s marketing practices and activities for contractual compliance, at Equidata’s expense, and inspect its business location at any time. [SteelVaultCorp_20081224_10-K_EX-10.16_3074935_EX-10.16_Affiliate Agreement.pdf p. 2]
- **Sykes HealthPlan Services Outsourcing Agreement** — SHPS may examine, copy, and audit HPS’s Care Management Revenue records upon reasonable prior written notice. [SYKESHEALTHPLANSERVICESINC_04_24_1998-EX-10.14-OUTSOURCING AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **Todos Medical Marketing/Reseller Agreement** — Todos may have an independent auditor inspect and audit the reseller’s relevant accounting and sales records on five days’ prior written notice during normal business hours. [TodosMedicalLtd_20190328_20-F_EX-4.10_11587157_EX-4.10_Marketing Agreement_ Reseller Agreement.pdf p. 5]

It permits conditional termination on 30 days’ notice and automatically terminates one year after a sale of the company. Neither is irrevocably perpetual; both have termination provisions. [SEPARATEACCOUNTIIOFAGL_05_02_2011-EX-99.(J)(4)-UNCONDITIONAL CAPITAL MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT.PDF p. 3] [FuseMedicalInc_20190321_10-K_EX-10.43_11575454_EX-10.43_Distributor Agreement.pdf p. 10]
